property_summary: For any admissible filled order, fillOrder must record positionExpirations[long order hash] = block.timestamp + order.duration; the mutant never writes it, so the stored expiration stays 0 and a filled long order has a zero expiration for any duration > 0.
change_summary: Delete the positionExpirations assignment entirely, so no key is written during fillOrder and reads return 0 instead of the timestamp + duration.
